lessons.title: A Family's Morning
lessons.context: A short story about a family's morning routine.

paragraphs.dari: صبح همه زود از خواب بیدار می‌شوند.
paragraphs.en: In the morning everyone wakes up early.

paragraphs.dari: مادر در آشپزخانه چای و نان آماده می‌کند.
paragraphs.en: The mother prepares tea and bread in the kitchen.

paragraphs.dari: پدر روزنامه می‌خواند و چای می‌نوشد.
paragraphs.en: The father reads the newspaper and drinks tea.

paragraphs.dari: بچه‌ها لباس مکتب می‌پوشند.
paragraphs.en: The children put on clothes for school.

paragraphs.dari: همه با هم صبحانه می‌خورند و بعد از خانه می‌روند.
paragraphs.en: Everyone eats breakfast together and then leaves the house.

questions.question: Who prepares tea and bread?
What does the father do?
options: He reads the newspaper and drinks tea

questions.question: What do the children put on?
What do they do after breakfast?

lessons.title: A Trip to the Bazaar
lessons.context: A short story about a family visit to the bazaar.

paragraphs.dari: احمد و خواهرش به بازار می‌روند.
paragraphs.en: Ahmad and his sister go to the bazaar.

paragraphs.dari: در بازار دکان‌های زیادی است.
paragraphs.en: There are many shops in the bazaar.

paragraphs.dari: آن‌ها سیب، کیله و شیر می‌خرند.
paragraphs.en: They buy apples, bananas, and milk.

paragraphs.dari: یک دکاندار به آن‌ها یک پیراهن نو نشان می‌دهد.
paragraphs.en: A shopkeeper shows them a new shirt.

paragraphs.dari: احمد خوشحال است زیرا چیزهای خوب خرید.
paragraphs.en: Ahmad is happy because he bought good things.

questions.question: Who goes to the bazaar?
What do they buy?
What does the shopkeeper show them?
Why is Ahmad happy?

lessons.title: My House
lessons.context: A short description of a family home.

paragraphs.dari: خانه من کوچک اما زیبا است.
paragraphs.en: My house is small but beautiful.

paragraphs.dari: در خانه سه اتاق، یک آشپزخانه و یک باغ است.
paragraphs.en: In the house there are three rooms, a kitchen, and a garden.

paragraphs.dari: اتاق من نزدیک کلکین است.
paragraphs.en: My room is near the window.

paragraphs.dari: همه ما با هم خانه را پاک می‌کنیم.
paragraphs.en: We all together clean the house.

paragraphs.dari: من خانه‌ام را خیلی دوست دارم.
paragraphs.en: I like my house a lot.

questions.question: How is the house described?
What is in the house?
options: Three rooms, a kitchen, and a garden

questions.question: Where is the writer's room?
What do they do together?

lessons.title: My Family
lessons.context: A short description of a family.

paragraphs.dari: در خانواده من پنج نفر است.
paragraphs.en: In my family there are five people.

paragraphs.dari: پدر، مادر، خواهر و برادرم مرا دوست دارند.
paragraphs.en: My father, mother, sister, and brother love me.

paragraphs.dari: هر یکشنبه همه ما با هم غذا می‌خوریم.
paragraphs.en: Every Sunday we all eat food together.

paragraphs.dari: خواهرم می‌خواهد داکتر شود.
paragraphs.en: My sister wants to become a doctor.

paragraphs.dari: خانواده من برایم با ارزش‌ترین چیز است.
paragraphs.en: My family is the most precious thing for me.

questions.question: How many people are in the family?
What do they do every Sunday?
What does the sister want to become?
What is the most precious thing for the writer?

lessons.title: A Rainy Day
lessons.context: A short story about a rainy day.

paragraphs.dari: امروز از صبح باران می‌بارد.
paragraphs.en: It has been raining since this morning.

paragraphs.dari: در آسمان ابرهای سیاه است و هوا سرد است.
paragraphs.en: There are black clouds in the sky and the air is cold.

paragraphs.dari: بچه‌ها از کلکین باران را می‌بینند.
paragraphs.en: The children are watching the rain from the window.

paragraphs.dari: مادر چای گرم می‌سازد و همه با هم می‌نوشند.
paragraphs.en: Mother makes hot tea and everyone drinks it together.

paragraphs.dari: روز بارانی در خانه خیلی خوب است.
paragraphs.en: A rainy day feels very good at home.

questions.question: Since when has it been raining?
What is in the sky?
What are the children doing?
options: Watching the rain from the window

questions.question: What does mother make?

lessons.title: My Best Friend
lessons.context: A short description of a close friendship.

paragraphs.dari: بهترین دوست من احمد است.
paragraphs.en: My best friend is Ahmad.

paragraphs.dari: او خیلی مهربان و صادق است.
paragraphs.en: He is very kind and honest.

paragraphs.dari: ما هر روز در مکتب با هم بازی می‌کنیم.
paragraphs.en: We play together every day at school.

paragraphs.dari: وقتی من مشکل دارم، او همیشه به من کمک می‌کند.
paragraphs.en: When I have difficulty, he always helps me.

paragraphs.dari: من خوش‌بخت هستم که چنین دوست خوبی دارم.
paragraphs.en: I am lucky that I have such a good friend.

questions.question: What is the friend's name?
How is he described?
When do they play together?
What does he do when the writer has difficulty?

lessons.title: Animals on a Farm
lessons.context: A short passage about farm animals.

paragraphs.dari: در مزرعه پدرکلانم حیوانات زیادی است.
paragraphs.en: There are many animals on my grandfather's farm.

paragraphs.dari: گاو شیر می‌دهد و مرغ تخم مرغ می‌دهد.
paragraphs.en: The cow gives milk and the hen gives eggs.

paragraphs.dari: بز و گوسفند علف می‌خورند.
paragraphs.en: The goat and the sheep eat grass.

paragraphs.dari: سگ هر شب از مزرعه محافظت می‌کند.
paragraphs.en: The dog protects the farm every night.

paragraphs.dari: من دوست دارم با حیوانات در مزرعه باشم.
paragraphs.en: I like being with the animals on the farm.

questions.question: What does the cow give?
What do the goat and sheep eat?
What does the dog do every night?
What does the writer like?

lessons.title: My Favorite Food
lessons.context: A short passage about a favorite dish.

paragraphs.dari: غذای مورد علاقه من برنج و دال است.
paragraphs.en: My favorite food is rice and lentils.

paragraphs.dari: مادرم آن را هر جمعه می‌سازد.
paragraphs.en: My mother makes it every Friday.

paragraphs.dari: در این غذا پیاز، بادنجان و ادویه است.
paragraphs.en: This food has onion, eggplant, and spices.

paragraphs.dari: تمام خانواده با هم آن را می‌خورند.
paragraphs.en: The whole family eats it together.

paragraphs.dari: خوردن این غذا برایم خیلی خوشی می‌آورد.
paragraphs.en: Eating this food brings me a lot of happiness.

questions.question: What is the writer's favorite food?
When does mother make it?
What is in the food?
Who eats it together?

lessons.title: A Day at School
lessons.context: A short story about a school day.

paragraphs.dari: من هر روز صبح ساعت هشت به مکتب می‌روم.
paragraphs.en: I go to school every morning at eight o'clock.

paragraphs.dari: در درس اول کتاب می‌خوانیم و می‌نویسیم.
paragraphs.en: In the first lesson we read the book and write.

paragraphs.dari: ظهر با دوستانم غذا می‌خوریم.
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon we eat food with friends.

paragraphs.dari: معلم چیزهای نو به ما یاد می‌دهد و ما سوال می‌پرسیم.
paragraphs.en: The teacher teaches us new things and we ask questions.

paragraphs.dari: بعد از مکتب به خانه آمده کارم را می‌کنم.
paragraphs.en: After school, coming home, I do my work.

questions.question: What time does the writer go to school?
What do they do in the first lesson?
Who do they eat with in the afternoon?
What does the writer do after coming home?

lessons.title: The Four Seasons
lessons.context: A short passage about the four seasons.

paragraphs.dari: در یک سال چهار فصل است.
paragraphs.en: In a year there are four seasons.

paragraphs.dari: در تابستان روزها طولانی و گرم هستند.
paragraphs.en: In summer the days are long and hot.

paragraphs.dari: در زمستان هوا سرد است و مردم لباس گرم می‌پوشند.
paragraphs.en: In winter the air is cold and people wear warm clothes.

paragraphs.dari: در بهار گل‌ها زیبا هستند و همه جا رنگ است.
paragraphs.en: In spring flowers are beautiful and there are colors everywhere.

paragraphs.dari: در خزان برگ‌ها زرد می‌شوند و روی زمین می‌افتند.
paragraphs.en: In autumn leaves turn yellow and fall on the ground.

questions.question: How many seasons are there in a year?
How are the days in summer?
What do people wear in winter?
What happens in spring?

lessons.title: Colors Around Us
lessons.context: A short passage about colors in daily life.

paragraphs.dari: به دور ما رنگ‌های زیادی است.
paragraphs.en: There are many colors around us.

paragraphs.dari: آسمان آبی است و علف سبز است.
paragraphs.en: The sky is blue and the grass is green.

paragraphs.dari: آفتاب زرد و روشن به نظر می‌رسد.
paragraphs.en: The sun looks yellow and bright.

paragraphs.dari: گل‌ها سرخ، زرد و سفید هستند.
paragraphs.en: Flowers are red, yellow, and white.

paragraphs.dari: رنگ‌ها زندگی ما را زیبا می‌سازند.
paragraphs.en: Colors make our life beautiful.

questions.question: What color is the sky?
What color is the grass?
How does the sun look?
What do colors do, according to the passage?

lessons.title: Going to the Doctor
lessons.context: A short story about a visit to the doctor.

paragraphs.dari: دیروز سردردی داشتم و تب هم داشتم.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday I had a headache and I also had a fever.

paragraphs.dari: مادرم مرا نزد داکتر برد.
paragraphs.en: My mother took me to the doctor.

paragraphs.dari: داکتر مرا دید و دوا داد.
paragraphs.en: The doctor examined me and gave medicine.

paragraphs.dari: او گفت که باید استراحت کنم و آب زیاد بنوشم.
paragraphs.en: He said that I should rest and drink more water.

paragraphs.dari: امروز بهتر احساس می‌کنم.
paragraphs.en: Today I am feeling better.

questions.question: What was wrong with the writer yesterday?
Who took the writer to the doctor?
What did the doctor give?
What did the doctor say to do?

lessons.title: My Daily Routine
lessons.context: A short passage about a daily routine.

paragraphs.dari: من هر روز صبح ساعت شش بیدار می‌شوم.
paragraphs.en: I wake up every morning at six o'clock.

paragraphs.dari: اول حمام می‌کنم و بعد صبحانه می‌خورم.
paragraphs.en: First I bathe and then I have breakfast.

paragraphs.dari: بعد از آن به کار می‌روم و تا شام آنجا می‌مانم.
paragraphs.en: After that I go to work and stay there until evening.

paragraphs.dari: شب کتاب می‌خوانم و زود می‌خوابم.
paragraphs.en: At night I read a book and sleep early.

paragraphs.dari: این کار روزمره مرا سالم نگه می‌دارد.
paragraphs.en: This routine keeps me healthy.

questions.question: What time does the writer wake up?
What does the writer do first?
Where does the writer stay until evening?
What does this routine do?

lessons.title: Numbers and Shopping
lessons.context: A short story about shopping and counting money.

paragraphs.dari: من به دکان رفتم و سه پیراهن خریدم.
paragraphs.en: I went to the shop and bought three shirts.

paragraphs.dari: قیمت هر پیراهن پنجصد افغانی بود.
paragraphs.en: The price of every shirt was five hundred afghanis.

paragraphs.dari: من به دکاندار پول دادم و او باقی پول را به من داد.
paragraphs.en: I gave the shopkeeper money and he gave me the rest of the money.

paragraphs.dari: به خانه رفته پیراهن‌های نو خود را به همه نشان دادم.
paragraphs.en: Going home I showed my new shirts to everyone.

paragraphs.dari: من خرید کردن را خیلی دوست دارم.
paragraphs.en: I like shopping a lot.

questions.question: How many shirts did the writer buy?
What was the price of each shirt?
What did the shopkeeper give back?
What does the writer like?

lessons.title: A Birthday Party
lessons.context: A short story about a birthday celebration.

paragraphs.dari: امروز تولد خواهرم است.
paragraphs.en: Today is my sister's birthday.

paragraphs.dari: ما خانه را با بادکنک‌های رنگارنگ آراستیم.
paragraphs.en: We decorated the house with colorful balloons.

paragraphs.dari: مادر یک کیک بزرگ و شیرین ساخت.
paragraphs.en: Mother made a big and sweet cake.

paragraphs.dari: همه دوستان و اعضای خانواده آمدند و تحفه آوردند.
paragraphs.en: All friends and family members came and brought gifts.

paragraphs.dari: این تولد یک روز خوشی در زندگی ما بود.
paragraphs.en: This birthday was a happy day in our life.

questions.question: Whose birthday is it?
How did they decorate the house?
What did mother make?
What did friends and family bring?
